LanguageData.PhobosDepot_Reached: {CARAVAN} has reached the depot. Its vehicles and crates are laid out here: drive the vehicles away and pick up what you need. Anything left lying here when you go waits for the next visit.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_GizmoAt: Leave and take at the depot
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_GizmoDesc: Leave vehicles, trailers and cargo here for a later trip: fuel cans, parts, food, a bowser with a full tank. Whatever is left waits here for as long as it takes. At a depot already here, you can also take cargo from it.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_WindowHint: Tick the vehicles to leave here, and choose how much cargo to leave or take. A vehicle left keeps its own cargo and the fuel in its tank. Anyone riding in it gets out and walks with the convoy.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_TakeItems: Cargo to take from the depot
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_TakeVehiclesNote: To take a vehicle back, or the cargo inside one, visit the depot: right-click it with a caravan.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_NotOurs: Only your own convoys can use a depot.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_TileTaken: {PLACE} is here already: a depot needs open ground.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_KeepOne: The convoy must keep at least one vehicle of its own. To leave every vehicle, use the convoy's own Stash command.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_NothingToPour: The depot holds none of the fuel these vehicles burn, or their tanks are full.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_Refuelled: {CONVOY} refuelled from the depot: {AMOUNT} units poured.
LanguageData.PhobosDepot_AircraftStopped: {VEHICLE} set down at {DEPOT} and took on {AMOUNT} {FUEL}. It lifts off again in {TIME}.
